campaign.title: Find the actual signed mechanism in the generic single-lift M2 band

conductor_policy.monitoring: Conductor checks exact support, signed p conventions, residue symmetries, critical-band normalization, endpoint powers, and theorem provenance.
conductor_policy.round_close: Close on the smallest actual-coefficient cancellation lemma or a rigorous route obstruction. Do not accept an envelope-only argument or a numerical trend.

numerical_purpose: generate a precise analytically testable conjecture
resource_policy.numerical_prohibition: Numerics cannot promote an asymptotic statement.
resource_policy.literature_policy: Search primary literature and audit exact hypotheses before importing any reciprocal-sum estimate.

frozen_target.question: Can the actual chi_4 structure in the single-lift q asymp D sector produce the missing critical off-diagonal cancellation?
frozen_target.reference_formula: For reduced p/q with D<=q<2D and 1<=|p|<=H_D, A_chi(p/q)=beta_{p,H_D}w_D(q), beta_p=-Phi(|p|/(H_D+1))chi_4(p)/(pi p) for odd signed p.
frozen_target.critical_form: D^(-2) Re sum_{0<|r-s|<=kappa/X} R_chi(r) conjugate(R_chi(s)) K(X(r-s)/4).
forbidden_conflations: p=1 subtotal and full signed form
chi_4(p) and chi_4(|p|) without the signed 1/p factor
smaller Li-Yang height range and top M2 block

tasks.target: Starting only from the audited beta formula, derive the exact single-lift coefficient system for D<=q<2D, including signed p, parity, coprimality, p<0 symmetry, pair convolution, and the critical near-pair-sum condition. Search for exact residue-class pairings or involutions that yield cancellation; prove them or exhibit the first obstruction. Do not inspect Round 3 conclusions.

Attack the top frequency block L asymp D X^(-1/4) using the exact rho=1,3 phase difference. Quantify what direct van der Corput, Poisson/stationary phase, large-sieve, or primary-source Bombieri-Iwaniec estimates actually give. Identify any smaller-L range already covered and state the exact exponent deficit at the top. Propose the weakest new analytic lemma that would close the deficit.

Hostilely test proposed generic-band cancellation mechanisms. Analytically compare actual, unsigned, residue-randomized, and B1-envelope coefficient systems. You may use a small exact-rational or high-precision Python/Mathematica diagnostic only to falsify residue-pairing conjectures or propose a precise lemma; archive code, parameters, outputs, and limitations. Seek a rigorous lower-bound subfamily or a cancellation identity.

completion_criteria: Exact generic-band algebra is independently rederived.
At least one actual-sign mechanism is proved or rigorously obstructed.
Top-block method feasibility is quantified from primary sources.
Signed, unsigned, and adversarial controls are passed.
campaign.promotion_policy: Round 4 may promote a scoped actual-coefficient lemma or obstruction only. No M9-M2, M9, or final-theorem promotion is permitted.
